text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to dance more gracefully and swishy!
Dantsu-san, teach me, teach me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehh~!? Uuuuum...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking into the dance studio, Dantsu Flame
was being bombarded with questions from Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... Mayano-chan said
she wants some tips on ballroom dancing.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya can already do
super fierce, cool dancing! So...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next, I want a super pretty, sparkly dance!
That'd be sooo grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Dants-san is super good at that kind of thing!
Maya saw it during our joint class earlier!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she had class right up until just now.
Still, to think Dants Flame was so good at ballroom dancing.
choice_data_list: Is there a trick to it?
I wonder if there's a trick to it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Not really... It feels more like
I'm just desperately trying to keep up with everyone...
choice_data_list: In that case... is there anything you're keeping in mind?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Maybe I do think about
matching the opponent's pace. Even in class earlier—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Dants! Let's pick up the pace.
Being stiff and formal just ain't my style!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wait, Pokke-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, I'm being pulled—!!
I have to pull my arms in more...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm? Pokke-chan,
were you looking behind me?
Do you want to head this way?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Then... I'll clear a path on the right
so Pokke-chan can slip in easier...!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...!
Haha, you get it, Dants!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The movement of their hands, the direction they pull, their gaze...
It's about watching your partner and syncing up with them.
choice_data_list: Amazing...! You've thought that much into it?!
Amazing...! You've put so much thought into it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~, if I don't do at least this much,
I'll barely be able to keep up...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Maya gets it now!
It means Dants-san is totally on edge, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Dants-san, you're looking all over the place
and thinking really hard while dancing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My whole body is razor-focused!
That's why my dancing looks so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...? Is... that so? Thank you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... observing her opponent so closely has sharpened her own senses as well.
choice_data_list: Maybe that's something only you can do, Dantsu
Maybe that's something only you can do, Dantsu
Why don't the two of you try dancing together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... observing her opponent so closely has sharpened her own senses as well.
choice_data_list: Maybe that's something only you can do, Dantsu
Maybe that's something only you can do, Dantsu
Why don't the two of you try dancing together?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list: It means it's thanks to you always paying close attention to your surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Dants-san!
Maya wants to see you dance
a whole lot more!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A sharp, poised pose, then a breezy, flowing dance!
Doesn't that sound great? Right?☆
choice_data_list: Since you're already here, why don't you dance for them?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-You too, Trainer-san!?
Umm, err~...—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
……All... right.
Just for a little bit, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a truly beautiful dance, with focus flowing through every part of her body!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's awesome~!
Let's do it, let's do it! Right, Dants-san?
Here, take Maya's hand♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, Pokke-chan was wearing something like this, right... Mayano-chan, what do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah, my body's moving on its own... It's so easy to dance!
Dantsu-san, you're amazing, so amazing☆

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, y-you think so...?
...Ehehe. Thanks, Mayano-chan!
